jobs.facts: As a Venture Builder with 20 years of experience, we create startups from the ground up (0→1). | How it works: Apply: Fill the form in the next step The Match: When a project perfectly aligned with your skills kicks off, we contact you and skip the "getting to know you" phase—moving straight to the next recruitment stage.

jobs.title: DESARROLLADOR FRONTEND (REACT)
jobs.facts: 🧑‍💻 Desarrollador/a Frontend React – Proyecto Internacional ¿Te gustaría formar parte de un equipo que desarrolla soluciones tecnológicas para una de las empresas más grandes de México?

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.facts: Requirements What you'll bring: Hands-on 4+ years of professional software engineering experience working on building SaaS applications in frontend capacity using Angular. | High level of expertise with TypeScript. | Strong understanding of RxJS and state management tools such as NgRx (or Redux, MobX, etc.), and practical experience applying reactive programming patterns in complex applications. | Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills. | As a Unifone you will receive a range of benefits: Competitive salary and bonus.
jobs.remoteProof: Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world!
